sourceTitle: How to make Schezwan Instant Noodles
sourceText:
How to make Schezwan Instant Noodles
By: ravikumar
Published: Wednesday, September 6, 2017 - 4:24am

Ingredients




1 Packet Ching's Secret Schezwan Instant Noodles
1 1/2 Cup (250ml) Water

Preparation

1 Step 1: 2 Boil 1 1/2 Cup (250ml) Water 3 Step 2: 4 Addd noodles and the seasoning mix to the boiling water and cook for 2-3 mins. Stir Occasionally. 5 Serve Hot!

About

Chings schezwan instant noodles are very tasty noodle as its major flavour is schezwan which is favourite of Food Lovers so it is really appreciable for those who personally like schezwan flavour. Each time when you eat it, you get satisfied, so the flavour satisfaction is very good and it is easy to make also. The Taste of the schezwan instant noodles is Authentic and Delicious as it uses Indian Herbs and Chinese Cuisine.
